lines: d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Lauren Rice is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d40: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d40: 🕯️ Lauren is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d40: Ashford watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d40: 🕯️ Lauren Rice is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d40: What Lauren kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d40: "Lauren's gone." Desmond looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Lauren." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d40: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Dylan blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Scarecrow (Level 1). You can stage a fake injury to lure monsters into traps. They fall for it. Every time.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d40: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Lauren Rice, 40 days. The mantle passes to Dylan Owens.
d40: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Dylan Owens, 39 — a hunting guide. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Echo Location, Dowsing, Green Whisper, Berserker Rage, Water Breathing.
d40: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Cartographer of the All-Seeing." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d40: The village's quarrel was with Lauren — and Lauren is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d40: At the grave, Natalie, Gertrude, Evdokia and 4 more speak for Dylan — "Lauren trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d40: The fire knew Dylan before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
